caption: Ducal Palace on the Metauro, Urbania
composition: Long brick Palazzo Ducale and arched bridge beside the Metauro · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From across the river the camera faces the long brick Ducal Palace filling the left and center, its arched loggia running at water level along the Metauro. A stone bridge with several arches crosses the river on the right, and the old town's rooftops rise behind. The 14:37 afternoon sun warms the brick.
